final: WITH event_groups AS (SELECT b.link_to_event, e.status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS group_average FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON b.link_to_event COLLATE BINARY = e.event_id COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.status), status_averages AS (SELECT status, AVG(group_average) AS status_average FROM event_groups GROUP BY status), joined_groups AS (SELECT g.group_average, g.group_average / s.status_average AS ratio FROM event_groups AS g JOIN status_averages AS s ON g.status COLLATE BINARY = s.status COLLATE BINARY), overall AS (SELECT AVG(group_average) AS overall_average FROM joined_groups) SELECT AVG(j.group_average), AVG(j.ratio), AVG(j.group_average - o.overall_average) FROM joined_groups AS j CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_average IS NOT NULL AND j.group_average > o.overall_average
